A '''shock controller''' was a device capable of remotely activating a [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collar]]. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] possessed a shock controller that activated the shock collar worn by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during her time as one of his [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. During the [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescue]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Organa managed to strangle Jabba with her chain, preventing him from reaching the shock controller as she killed him.<ref name="EGWT" />
